description: This source file defines the HoverHUDController class for managing a hover-only heads-up display (HUD) in a macOS application. It handles presenting and dismissing a HUD anchored to a menu bar item, managing hover interactions, and integrating with SwiftUI views.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A controller managing the lifecycle, presentation, and interaction of a hover HUD in macOS, including hover detection, show/hide animations, and integration with SwiftUI views.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets whether the HUD is suppressed and cancels show/dismiss tasks accordingly.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in hover state over the status item, scheduling show or dismiss actions.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the HUD panel, scheduling dismiss when hover exits.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the Web Chat panel anchored to the current position.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD, optionally with a reason, and executes the hide animation.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules a task to dismiss the HUD after a delay if hover exit conditions persist.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Ensures the HUD window is created and presents it with animation.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the window if it does not exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for positioning the HUD based on anchor or default placement.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame to match the target, optionally with animation.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Sets up global event monitoring for mouse clicks outside the HUD to trigger dismissal.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global event monitor for outside clicks.
